description.value:
You fire a cryogenic burst from your omni-tool that flash-freezes targets in a wide area, slowing their movements.

All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot radius burst} within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-cryo-blast] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[cold]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[cold]] damage and is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[cold]] damage and is Immobilized until the end of its next turn. If the target is already Slowed, it is Immobilized instead.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
